full_judgment:
7. The defendants has been resisting the suit by presenting a written statement traversing all the material allegations madein the plaint contending, inter alia, that one pious Muslim built a Mosque during the Mughal period for offering prayer by religious Muslims and dedicated his property in the name of "Allah". There was Hujrakhana for Imam of the Mosque and Imam used to stay there. On the fall of Nawab Serajuddowla, the then employees of East India Company, for the education of their children, decided to establish schools and for that purpose forcibly possessed the graveyard and other land of the Mosque. During Cadestral Survey Record of Right 0.0784 acre of land was recorded in Khatian No. 8941 in the name of Moulvi Ibrahim, the Mutwalli. The stand taken by the defendants is that during the State Acquisition Record of Right 0.0180 acre of land stood recorded in the name of the Plaintiff School wrongly and the Record of Right had been prepared by the plaintiff in collusion with the settlement officers. Further positive averment made by the defendants is that, the Hujrakhana is on 0.078 acre of land of Cadestral Survey Plot No. 3 and the plaintiff St Francis Xavier's Girls High School is on Cadestral Survey Plot No.2. It is also averred that the land of Cadestral Survey Plot No. 2 and the land of Cadestral Survey Plot No. 3 and the structure standing thereon are absolutely different. The defendant Mosque laid a suit for the correction of the said State Acquisition Record of Right standing in the name of the Plaintiff School. 

 2. To measure the land of the defendant recorded in CS Khatian No. 8941 by relaying CS Map of Sheet No. 53 and to show the existing structures thereon. 

 District Dhaka, Police Station and Mouza Sutrapur, CS Khatian No. 17008, SA Khatian No. 337, SA Plot No. 802, the total area of land is 1.4010 acres, the suit property is about 2.75 decimals/about 1.67 kathas having area: eastern side is 26 feet 5 inches; the western side 40 feet 9 inches; in the southern side 28 feet 9 inches and in northern side 42 feet 5 inches which is bounded by the north Road, by the south the defendant Mosque, by the west plaintiffs land of Plot No. 802 and the east a small passage for ingress and egress. The suit property is about 2.75 decimals with building thereon. The municipal holding number of the School is 86-87, Subash Bose Avenue, Dhaka."
